description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the Receiver class within the Eclipse Hono CLI application. It verifies starting behavior of Receiver with different message types and uses mocks for external dependencies.

classes.name: ReceiverTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the Receiver class in the Eclipse Hono CLI application.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Receiver instance with mocked Vertx and ApplicationClientFactory dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testTelemetryStart
methods.description: Tests that the Receiver successfully starts and processes telemetry messages when messageType is 'telemetry'.

methods.name: testEventStart
methods.description: Tests that the Receiver successfully starts and processes event messages when messageType is 'event'.

methods.name: testDefaultStart
methods.description: Tests that the Receiver successfully starts and processes both telemetry and event messages when messageType is set to 'all'.

methods.name: testInvalidTypeStart
methods.description: Tests that the Receiver fails to start when an invalid messageType is provided.
